verdicts.justification: Repro crashes exactly as claimed: 'ValueError: `x` must contain at least 2 elements.' raised from hypertools/_shared/helpers.py:140 (q=pchip(x,arr)) via plot.py:2328 interp_array_list. Order-dependence also confirmed: reversed list [1-row, 25-row] does NOT crash but silently disables smoothing (per-artist point counts [1, 25]) while the solo 25-row dataset gets [900] interpolated points. All-1-row list renders markers (counts [1, 1]) and mixed list with fmt='.' works, so the crash is specific to default line fmt with a multi-row dataset first. Evidence PNGs (X8_192_verbatim_all1row.png, X8_192_mixed_markers_ok.png) match those working cases. Crash + inconsistent order-dependent output on a plausible input; major.
commands_run: MPLBACKEND=Agg .venv/bin/python -c "import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp; np.random.seed(1); hyp.plot([np.random.randn(25,3), np.random.randn(1,3)], show=False)"
MPLBACKEND=Agg .venv/bin/python <reverse-order + solo + all-1-row + fmt='.' comparison script; printed per-artist point counts>
